content.text: Persistently ↑TG 150–499 mg/dL w LDL-C <100 mg/dL on max tolerated statin: adding IPE may be reasonable to ↓ASCVD risk.
Vascepa: adjunct to max tolerated statin to ↓CV risk w TG ≥150 mg/dL and established CVD, or DM + ≥2 other RFs.
